Hi Ava,

Hope you’re well — I’m reaching out from Acme Corp finance. We received the March AWS Marketplace invoice that flowed through Redwood and noticed a ~€28,400 line labeled "reserve/withholding adjustment" that doesn't map to any of our internal usage or subscriptions. The invoice reference is #AC-2027-03-RW.

We need:
- A line-item breakout showing the original marketplace usage by SKU and timestamp (UTC).
- Any withholding or tax routing adjustments that Redwood applied before payout.
- Evidence that we were notified of the withholding policy (email/contract link).

Attached: our copy of the invoice and a quick CSV from our billing system. Can you loop in whoever manages marketplace settlements on your side? We’re on a tight close — this will block our month-end reconciliation.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Discrepancy in AWS Marketplace invoice (March 2027) - immediate help needed

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice. I’m pulling the marketplace settlement details now. Quick notes:

- We don’t apply withholding on top of AWS settlement lines ourselves; in most cases marketplace withholdings are applied by the cloud marketplace provider at payout time.
- That said, we do have routing rules that can change whether revenue is recorded in Redwood-managed ledger vs. pass-through — I’ll confirm if that could create an adjustment label in the copy you received.

Action plan I’m starting:
1) Jonas is pulling the raw SKU-level metering logs and the per-transaction timestamps that were consumed by AWS for Acme’s seller listing.
2) I’ll request the settlement reconciliation that Redwood received from AWS for March (this shows withholds, fees, and currency conversions).
3) Ben will surface any contract/TOU notices sent to Acme that mention withholding or marketplace pass-through.

Can you confirm the Acme legal entity and VAT registration we should cite for evidence? If you have a VAT certificate or proof of non-resident status, please attach it.

I’ll update within 24 hours with what we have.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Lead, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai

Elena / Ava,

I pulled the per-SKU metering export for Acme between 2027-03-01T00:00:00Z and 2027-03-31T23:59:59Z. I’m attaching a filtered snapshot (usage_snapshot_2027-03.csv) with:
- timestamp_utc
- marketplace_sku
- customer_account_id

Preliminary observation: the Redwood ledger shows a set of 3 reversal lines dated 2027-03-29 that correspond to a billing region remap (eu-west-1 -> eu-west-2) for a small subset of SKUs; that caused a currency revaluation. The EUR adjustment should be smaller than what you’ve flagged.

I’ve also requested the settlement reconciliation from AWS billing ops (cc’d aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com in the next message). If AWS applied a regional withholding at payout, that will show up in their settlement file.

Attaching: usage_snapshot_2027-03.csv (filtered snapshot).

Subject: RE: Discrepancy in AWS Marketplace invoice (March 2027) - ledger / withholding clarification

Hello all,

Thanks for reaching out — I’m Samir from AWS Marketplace Seller Support. We’ve reviewed the settlement batch for Acme Corp (seller id: 2017-ACME-EU) for the March 2027 payout. Notes:

1) A mandatory withholding of 10% (EUR) was applied to a set of transactions where seller tax residency validation failed at payout time. The specific settlements are marked in our reconciliation file as WITHHOLD_TAX.
2) The withholding entries were later offset by credits once Acme submitted valid VAT registration evidence; the offset credit happened on 2027-04-05 but depending on the accounting ledger the credit may appear as a separate line item (negative) and could be labeled differently (reserve/withholding adjustment).
3) The timing mismatch between the initial withholding and the credit is likely what produced the ~€28k delta you saw on the March invoice: withholding in the March payout, credit applied in April settlement.

Attached: AWS_reconciliation_MAR2027.csv (we’ve provided the ledger keys and settlement_ids). Please confirm receipt of VAT evidence to trigger any manual reversal adjustments if needed.

Regards,
Samir Khan
AWS Marketplace Seller Support
aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com

Best,
Elena

Elena — thanks for the VAT docs. Quick status:

- AWS confirmed they received the VAT certificate and recorded a credit on 2027-04-05. The credit settlement_id is S-ACME-2027-04C (Samir copied above).
- On our side, the credit has been processed and you should see the reversal line hit your RedDebt ledger on 2027-04-20 EOD (we do end-of-day postings for marketplace credits so they batch correctly against forex).
- Action items for Acme: none required unless your accounting team wants the credit posted earlier as a manual journal (we can provide the settlement file and GL mapping if you want to push a manual adjustment).

I’ll send the final reconciliation file and GL mapping once the posting is complete. In the meantime I’ve added the HubSpot deal note (DEAL-4821) and created a shared Drive folder with the exports (link above).

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
